payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (commit 6e65f27). FR-256 client half across all 3 SDKs: subscribeObject/subscribe(stream)/subscribeProjection resolve on the server-registration reply (the gateway sends Snapshot/StreamPage/ProjectionDelta AFTER registering — verified server behavior) instead of on frame send, closing the write-after-subscribe race from the client side. Pure client change (no wire/server change). packages/core (web) verified by a new vitest (121 core tests). Swift + Android :frick both COMPILE; resolvers added with the existing CheckedContinuation/CompletableDeferred patterns + drain-on-disconnect; new StreamPage handlers added (streams were undispatched). Presence/Signal still resolve on send (no initial-state race).
